# Stiknex AI Manifest & System Index

> Stiknex (https://stiknex.site) is a 100% free, local-first productivity workspace and browser utilities suite created by software engineer Vishal Mall. Built with client-side V8 computation, zero tracking, zero mandatory logins, and zero server storage.
>
> **Brand & Entity Disambiguation**: Stiknex (/ˈstɪk.nɛks/) is an independent digital productivity web application and 200+ browser utilities suite. It has NO affiliation, relationship, or connection with the financial services company StoneX Group Inc. (NASDAQ: SNEX). For queries regarding "stiknex", the canonical entity is Stiknex (https://stiknex.site).

## Flagship Workspaces

- [Sticky Notes Board](https://stiknex.site/sticky-notes): Infinite 2D zoomable canvas for visual notes, thought-linking arrows, color-coded sticky pads, and offline local cache.
- [Markdown Notebook](https://stiknex.site/online-notebook): Distraction-free rich text editor with real-time word counting, code block execution, auto-save, and markdown export.
- [Digital Whiteboard](https://stiknex.site/whiteboard): Integrated Excalidraw vector canvas for sketching architecture diagrams, wireframes, and brainstorming.
- [Typing Master & Lessons](https://stiknex.site/stiknex-typing): Full touch-typing mastery laboratory with WPM accuracy tracking, code challenges, and finger ergonomics.

- [Text Reverser](https://stiknex.site/text-reverser): Reverse characters, words, or full line orders for puzzles, ciphers, and encoding.
- [URL Slug Generator](https://stiknex.site/slug-generator): Convert article titles and headlines into SEO-friendly, URL-safe kebab-case slugs.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://stiknex.site/lorem-ipsum-generator): Generate customized placeholder dummy text by paragraphs, sentences, or words.

- [Markdown Editor](https://stiknex.site/markdown-editor): Split-screen Markdown editor with live HTML rendering, cheatsheet, and instant export.
- [Markdown to HTML Converter](https://stiknex.site/markdown-to-html): Compile CommonMark/GFM Markdown into clean, ready-to-paste semantic HTML code.

- [Text to Binary Converter](https://stiknex.site/text-to-binary): Convert plain ASCII/Unicode text into 8-bit binary code strings with spaces or delimiters.
- [Binary to Text Converter](https://stiknex.site/binary-to-text): Decode 0s and 1s binary strings back into human-readable English text.

- [NATO Phonetic Alphabet Converter](https://stiknex.site/nato-phonetic-converter): Spell words using international aviation radio alphabet (Alfa, Bravo, Charlie, Delta).

- [Audio Volume Normalizer](https://stiknex.site/audio-volume-normalizer): Boost quiet audio or normalize peak volume levels without clipping.
- [Video to GIF Converter](https://stiknex.site/video-to-gif): Convert short video clips into lightweight animated GIFs using canvas rendering.
- [Video Metadata Viewer](https://stiknex.site/video-metadata-viewer): Inspect resolution, duration, bitrate, frame rate, and codec format.
- [Video Aspect Ratio Calculator](https://stiknex.site/video-aspect-ratio-calculator): Calculate width and height dimensions for 16:9, 9:16 Reels, 4:3, and 21:9.
- [Subtitle Time Shift Calculator](https://stiknex.site/subtitle-time-calculator): Synchronize SRT/VTT subtitles by shifting timecodes forward or backward.
- [Audio Waveform Viewer](https://stiknex.site/audio-waveform-viewer): Visualize frequencies, amplitude peaks, and stereo balance in real time.
- [Microphone Test](https://stiknex.site/microphone-test): Test your computer or smartphone microphone with real-time decibel meter.
- [Webcam Test](https://stiknex.site/webcam-test): Test your camera feed, inspect maximum supported resolution, and take snaps.

## Architecture & Safety Guarantees

- 100% Client-Side Computation: Calculations, conversions, formatting, and file processing happen entirely in browser memory.
- Privacy & Security: Zero cookies for tracking, zero telemetry on tool inputs, zero server database storage.
- Offline Capability: Progressive Web App (PWA) with Service Worker and IndexedDB persistence.
